slides.h: SHOOT LISTING PHOTOS ON THE PHONE [[YOU ALREADY OWN]]
slides.dek: A one-hour setup that makes your listings stop looking homemade. No studio, no new gear.

items: **Use one big window, all lamps off.** Mixed light turns whites yellow and confuses colours.
**Tape plain white chart paper** behind and under the product in one curve, so there is no corner line.
**Rest the phone on a stack of books.** A steady phone beats a steady hand, every shot.
**Wipe the lens first.** A smudged lens is the most common reason photos look cheap.
**Tap the product to focus, then drag exposure down a touch.** Slightly darker keeps detail.
**Never pinch to zoom.** Step closer instead. Digital zoom throws away sharpness.
**Five angles per product:** front, back, close-up of texture, in the hand, in real use.
**In-hand shots answer the size question.** Most disappointed reviews start with smaller than expected.
**Take ten frames of each angle.** Choosing later costs nothing. Reshooting costs a day.
**Adjust brightness and white balance only.** The photo is a promise you ship in a box.
**Never recolour the product.** Colour-mismatch returns are a self-inflicted cost.
**Keep one first-photo style across listings.** A matched grid reads as a brand.

slides.h: SAVE THIS FOR YOUR NEXT SHOOT DAY
slides.body: One window, one chart paper, one hour. Your top five listings deserve it this weekend.
